message: Initialized PicAiPic MEX long-term project memory from the current codebase, build manifests, plugin contract documents, and Git history; populated core context and seeded five recurring-task runbooks.

Keep PicAiPic MEX in code-repo mode and maintain AI plugin lifecycle/security as a dedicated context domain because it has independent contracts, runtimes, storage boundaries, and verification workflows.

Completed active-brand migration cleanup: main title bar now shows PicAiPic; updater release-note URL, backup name, map fallback label, VC++ dependency dialog, help menu, AI HTTP user agent, PR artifact names, and Chinese README platform/uninstall instructions now use current PicAiPic identity.

Confirmed cross-library protocol risk: thumb/preview URLs include library id but SQLite lookups use the current-library connection, so delayed requests after switching libraries can resolve duplicate numeric file ids against the wrong database.

Plugin manifest validation enforces pluginApi major but not compatibility.minPicAiPicVersion; package manager/version metadata is also inconsistent because CI uses pnpm while npm lockfiles remain, frontend is 0.2.4, and docs npm lock still names lap-website.

Protocol thumbnail and preview requests now open the database identified by the URL library id, validate that id against configured libraries, and write generated thumbnail cache data back to that same library.
Plugin compatibility now enforces min/max PicAiPic host versions in addition to pluginApi major; JavaScript tooling is standardized on pnpm and package metadata is aligned to 1.0.0.
Home view heavy panels and Content were converted to async components, reducing the Home production chunk from about 527 KB to about 15 KB and removing the Vite chunk-size warning.

Implemented Live Photo + Motion Photo support: Apple Live Photo (HEIC/JPEG+MOV via EXIF ContentIdentifier UUID pairing) and Google Motion Photo (JPEG with embedded MP4 via XMP Container:Directory offset extraction). DB schema migrated to v6 with content_id, paired_file_id, live_photo_type columns. New t_xmp.rs module uses quick-xml for XMP parsing. Long-press preview in MediaViewer with controlless video overlay. Thumbnail LIVE badge and FileInfo type label added.

HEIC container-internal video track extraction is NOT implemented — some Apple Live Photos embed the video in the HEIC container (not as a separate MOV). This requires extending libheif FFI (heif_context_get_list_of_top_level_image_IDs + metadata block API). Currently only HEIC+MOV dual-file mode works.
Update i18n: add 'Live Photo' and 'Motion Photo' labels to src-vite/src/locales/en.json and zh.json for proper localization. Currently the LIVE badge text and type labels are hardcoded in English.

Add automatic cleanup for Motion Photo temp files (currently written to std::env::temp_dir() with blake3 hash naming). Reuse or extend the existing video cache cleanup mechanism to periodically purge stale picaipic_motion_*.mp4 temp files.
P1 Motion Photo cache: extracts now use app_cache_dir/motion_cache with source-keyed reuse, 2GB prune, startup OS-temp purge; clear_video_cache also clears motion_cache.
P2a Live Photo export: t_live_photo still/video/pair, export_live_photo command, LivePhotoExportDialog + file menu; conversion (to_motion/to_pair/keyframe) and HEIC-internal video still future.
Packaged build showing no media likely from missing afiles Live Photo columns after v6 schema change; hardened ensure_live_photo_columns on migrate+open and made query_files tolerate bad rows.
P2b/P2c: export modes to_motion, to_pair, set_keyframe; Motion JPEG packaging in t_xmp; ffmpeg remux/keyframe helpers in t_video; dialog + i18n updated.
rename_file/rename_folder now rollback disk on DB failure; edit_album propagates name errors; get_files_by_sizes reuses suspicious sizes (chunked IN) instead of redundant GROUP BY
P3 HEIC-internal video: t_heif items/sequences FFI, live_photo_type=4 scan, extract to motion_cache, get_paired/export/MediaViewer wired.
MediaViewer: optional-chain props.file?.file_type in floating toolbar class; guard startLivePhotoPlayback when file is null
Confirmed MediaViewer props.file! already fixed; deduped parse_motion_content_id into t_xmp; corrected PairedVideoInfo type docs (1/3/4)
Docs sync 2026-07-17: picaipic-progress, 目前的开发情况, README/zh, live-photo pattern; ready to commit Live Photo + reliability fixes
Live Photo polish: set_keyframe overwrite_original (JPEG only, confirmed+staged), rescan_live_photo_metadata album repair, FileInfo export button, album menu repair entry.
Docs: live-photo user guide + progress/README/ROUTER accuracy (keyframe overwrite done; model dir binding done; one-click private runtime still open).

Implemented confirmed one-click shared→plugin-private runtime switch: host command switch_ai_plugin_profile_to_private_runtime persists synthetic plugin-private binding, clears profile probe cache, marks needsVerify; Settings conflict UI offers Use private runtime after confirmation; shared runtimes untouched; Setup remains user-driven.
Verified shared→private switch path with cargo check/test, cargo fmt, frontend build, and scripts/check_plugin_host.ps1. Docs/ROUTER/plugin-runtime updated for 2026-07-17.

Model UX reinforcement: expose modelFiles in list_ai_plugins; Settings open+validate managed model dir and import selected model files by basename into plugin-data models with containment checks; external binding open+validate.

Sandbox hardening is phased (docs/ai-plugin-sandbox-roadmap.md): Phase 0 enables cross-platform input staging and fail-closed staging errors; OS network/Landlock remain future opt-in spikes, not Settings UI work.
Staging still only rewrites JSON fields named path; plugins using other keys for file refs would bypass staging until the contract is extended.
Sandbox Phase 0 tail: InputStagingReport diagnostics on task message + staging-report.json; unit tests for rewrite/fail-closed/disabled; phase0 verify checklist doc.

Sandbox Phase 1: plugin_writable_roots is the host allow-list for staging skip + optional Windows ACL exclusions (data/cache/outputs/runtimes/code + shared runtimes + bound model dirs + task extras). Adoption stays task-output containment only.
Sandbox Phase 2: stage_one_file prefers same-volume hardlink then copy fallback; InputStagingReport tracks hardlinkedFiles/copiedFiles; fail-closed unchanged.

Docs sync 2026-07-18: sandbox Phase 0–2 marked done across ROUTER/plugin-runtime/progress/目前的开发情况/roadmap/security/current-status; Phase 3 network OS and Phase 4 Landlock explicitly not done; Phase 2 hardlink mainline done but not full zero-copy.

Synced sandbox Phase 0-2 done / Phase 3-4 not-done status across 目前的开发情况, picaipic-progress, roadmap phase board, ROUTER, plugin-runtime, security hardening, current-status, phase0-verify (2026-07-18).

Phase 0 Windows host-path acceptance: 5 input_staging tests + plugin-host green; C: library → D: plugin-cache proves hardlink fail / copy + staging-report.json. Full SA-LUT UI GPU invoke still optional.
SA-LUT full E2E: ROCm start + C:→D: staging (2 copy) + color-transfer produced PNG under plugin-cache task outputs (phase0-e2e-de513e5c).
